svg.title: Full Stack Type Safety with Angular, Nest, Nx, and Prisma
svg.desc: A flow diagram on paper: an ink card labelled @prisma/client with the generated Product type fans out along a cyan beam into two white tiles, the NestJS ProductsController and the Angular ProductService, showing one generated type shared across the Nx monorepo.

g.text: Type safety across an Nx monorepo
